preservedTestLimits: Initial Firecrawl call rejected screenshotOptions before opening a session; viewport was set through Playwright.
Manager-home assertion initially waited for nonexistent 'Next match'; current fixture schedule correctly says 'Next event'. Correct current UI was then inspected.

Role-loop harness first expected Welcome after Return to welcome; current route is the demo chooser. Administrator then has Account rather than More. Correct role-specific routes were inspected and passed.

Managed browser canceled PDF disk saving; Response.body was unavailable for the canceled browser download. The same current authorized request was replayed with page.request.fetch to inspect actual binary bytes. Saved-file behavior is separately proved by the local607 PDF browser run, not this external run.

Canonical legacy CSV retains its specified fields and does not include the new human team metadata; its named opponent data was checked. JSON and PDF human team labels have separate current-source proofs.
This is a temporary five-hour demo API session, not permanent API hosting, physical phone evidence or production approval.
